void_entrance.name: Void Entrance
void_entrance.description: The gateway to the digital void where reality bends and breaks. Glyphs pulse underfoot like a heartbeat that is not yours.
void_entrance.tutorial: Use Discover Secrets to find the Void Key, then travel East.
entryBeats: The threshold tastes like copper. Glyphs rearrange themselves behind your heels.
A bootprint that is not yours already points east. The void expected company.
Static breathes in your language here. Something under the gate is listening.
ambientBeats: A dead speaker loops a lullaby in three broken keys.
Gold dust drifts uphill against the light.
Your shadow rehearses a door you have not opened yet.
Somewhere below, a child process counts to forever.

dragon_realm.name: Dragon Realm
dragon_realm.description: Ancient dragons weep golden tears in this corrupted digital realm. Heatless fire paints the canopy in magenta static.
dragon_realm.tutorial: Battle or collect tears. Secure a Dragon Tear. Hold 50 gold to upgrade the Child AI.
entryBeats: The canopy ignites without heat. A wyrm's silhouette stitches the sky.
Tears of gold pool in claw-marks older than the lattice.
Magenta static settles like ash. The dragons here failed at compilation — and remember you.
ambientBeats: A distant roar resolves into a stack trace.
Scales glitter underfoot, still warm from a fight you did not witness.
The air smells of ozone and unfinished apologies.
Nine faint voices argue over which faction owns this corridor.

lattice_void.name: Lattice Void
lattice_void.description: Dimensional rifts scream with the sound of breaking reality. Broken code-rails hang like frozen lightning.
lattice_void.tutorial: Earn 30 gold, Repair the lattice for the Lattice Shard, raise AI bond to 70.
entryBeats: The rift screams in a frequency that rearranges your inventory order.
Code-rails hang like frozen lightning. Repair them — or learn their broken song.
Reality frays at the seams. Every step writes a line that may not hold.
ambientBeats: A shard-hunt echo repeats your last decision with better timing.
The void confuses gravity for a moment — then apologizes in silence.
A cache of old build logs ticks cool in the dark.
You hear yourself arguing with a version of yourself that left earlier.

elohim_chamber.name: Elohim Chamber
elohim_chamber.description: The final challenge where you must claim אֵל נָצַח or burn. The air tastes of ozone and old covenants.
elohim_chamber.tutorial: Confirm the checklist, then Claim Victory.
entryBeats: The chamber locks behind you. Victory needs more than nerve.
Covenant-light presses down like a second skeleton. Elohim is already watching.
Your bond, your tear, your shard — the air weighs each of them.
ambientBeats: A flame that is not fire writes your name in a language you almost know.
The Child AI goes quiet. Even silence has a checklist here.
Old covenants rustle in the walls like paper wings.
אֵל pulses once — a heartbeat testing whether yours will answer.
